_README: Expected answers are DESCRIBED, not named by object id. Ids are assigned
by the indexer and change every time the photos are re-indexed; the first
version of this file named them directly and reported 10% accuracy the
day the index was rebuilt, while nothing was actually broken.
Every descriptor here is copied from data/ground_truth.json, so a case
asks for something a person can see in the photo. If the index has no
object matching it, that is reported as MISSING - the indexer never found
it - and counted as recall, not as a reasoning mistake.
easy         one obvious match; answering with no questions is correct
ambiguous    several matches; answering with NO questions is a failure
duplicate    same thing in two rooms; location has to be asked
spatial      only a relation separates the candidates
small-object easy to miss at full-frame resolution
multilingual asked in Korean or Chinese
vocab-gap    known to fail: indexed, but no synonym to search it by
not-found    not in the building; saying so is the correct answer

note: only orange bag anywhere - should answer with zero questions
one keyfob in the ground truth - a second would make this ambiguous
bottles in five rooms; answering immediately is the failure this project exists to fix
pink umbrellas exist in two rooms as well - colour alone is not enough
chargers are the least distinguishable thing we index - a hard case on purpose
green bottles in three places - the location question is the only way through
genuinely the same umbrella carried to another room; both answers are places it was seen

query: Where is the mouse below the laptop?
note: two mice on that table; only the relation to the laptop separates them

query: Find the glasses on the laptop
Is there a bottle next to a phone?
note: the phone lies between the two bottles - either bottle is a correct answer

was a vocab gap - in the photo and in the index, but no word to search it by. Kept as a case so the fix stays fixed. No colour: the ground truth says beige and the model says white, which run_recall.py counts as an attribute error rather than a miss
also a former gap - the one object a person could see in the photo and still not search for
